(II) (SUBJECT TO SUCH MANNER OF CALCULATION AS MAY BE PRESCRIBED BY THE SINGAPORE EXCHANGE SECURITIES TRADING LIMITED (SGX-ST)) FOR THE PURPOSE OF DETERMINING THE AGGREGATE NUMBER OF SHARES THAT MAY BE ISSUED UNDER SUB-PARAGRAPH (I) ABOVE, THE PERCENTAGE OF ISSUED SHARES SHALL BE BASED ON THE TOTAL NUMBER OF ISSUED SHARES (EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES AND SUBSIDIARY HOLDINGS) AT THE TIME THIS RESOLUTION IS PASSED, AFTER ADJUSTING FOR: (A) NEW SHARES ARISING FROM THE CONVERSION OR EXERCISE OF ANY CONVERTIBLE SECURITIES OR SHARE OPTIONS OR VESTING OF SHARE AWARDS WHICH WERE ISSUED AND ARE OUTSTANDING OR SUBSISTING AT THE TIME THIS RESOLUTION IS PASSED;
